title: [Payables Agent] Fix stale Payables Agent setup save
summary: The Payables Agent Setup now persists instruction updates in a single final modification to prevent stale-record errors when applying agent instructions during setup.
key_points: Separated instruction application and hash calculation from immediate setup-record persistence
Consolidated user ID, E-document service code, and instruction hash updates into one final modification
Preserved existing hash persistence for upgrade and configuration-drift scenarios
